RECOMMENDATIONS

What the records suggest

How these insights work

We compare entered revenue, cost, water, harvest, and health records. Monthly net is cash flow by entry date; it is not crop-cycle profit. A strong past return does not guarantee the next one: weather, yield, market price, and soil conditions can change.
